title: Nifty IT Index, which tracks Indian IT stocks, has slumped about 15% so far in February on worries about AI and is on track for its worst month since March 2020 (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Nifty IT Index, which tracks Indian IT stocks, has slumped about 15% so far in February on worries about AI and is on track for its worst month since March 2020 — For investors bullish on India's technology services industry, the “AI scare trade” has created an opportunity to buy shares …
